coverageNote: A reviewed matrix of current pooled funds and still-live published Founders Pledge recommendations across four requested cause areas. Historical grantees are excluded unless an explicit recommendation page remains live. A live page is not proof of current room for more funding.
comparabilityWarning: Founders Pledge uses direct, modeled, partner-derived, and hits-based evaluation methods. Only Imagine Worldwide has an explicit GiveDirectly-relative multiple in this matrix. Funds and catastrophic-risk opportunities must not be ranked against that multiple.

records.evidenceModel: Active, hits-based grantmaking across neglected climate blindspots and bottlenecks
records.nativeMetric: No comparable organization-level emissions-per-dollar metric published
records.fundingStatus: Accepting donations; fund allocates across time-sensitive opportunities
records.summary: Founders Pledge's top-level climate vehicle uses active grantmaking to build a diversified portfolio of neglected, systems-level opportunities.
records.limitations: A pooled fund is not one intervention. Its current portfolio and marginal grant opportunities change over time, so past grantees and fund-level impact claims are not a stable rank.

records.evidenceModel: Risk-neutral, catalytic grantmaking across health, wealth, and opportunity
records.nativeMetric: No single current program-wide cost-effectiveness metric published
records.fundingStatus: Catalytic Impact Fund closed August 31, 2025; program support is by contact
records.summary: The current program seeks scalable, evidence-backed and catalytic opportunities that complement rather than duplicate other global-health funders.
records.limitations: The public page is a program strategy, not an active recommendations list. Its named grantees represent funding decisions at the time, not automatically current donor opportunities.

records.organization: Founders Pledge Global Catastrophic Risks Fund
records.evidenceModel: Hits-based active grantmaking across AI, biosecurity, nuclear risk, and great-power coordination
records.fundingStatus: Accepting donations; fund fills neglected and time-sensitive gaps
records.summary: The GCR Fund combines direct interventions, research, and higher-variance bets intended to reduce the probability or consequences of global catastrophes.
records.limitations: Deep uncertainty and heterogeneous risk pathways make its opportunities incomparable to direct-service cash or health estimates without an explicit model.

records.organization: Teaching at the Right Level Africa
records.evidenceModel: Modeled learning gains from government-partnered Teaching at the Right Level scale-up
records.nativeMetric: 0.03–0.05 standard deviations of total test-score gain per USD donated
records.fundingStatus: Recommendation page remains live; current numeric marginal gap not published
records.summary: Founders Pledge calls TaRL Africa its top recommended education charity and cites a large RCT base for ability-targeted instruction.
records.limitations: The estimate is a modeled educational outcome, not a cash multiple. The page says recommendations can change and does not publish a current 2026 funding gap.

records.evidenceModel: Founders Pledge education model linking test-score gains to later income and wellbeing
records.nativeMetric: Modeled wellbeing through higher income; roughly 0.2 SD learning gain at $15 per student-year in the worked example
records.fundingStatus: Published recommendation model; current numeric marginal gap not published
records.summary: The 2023 report estimates Imagine Worldwide at 11× GiveDirectly for wellbeing through higher income under its worked education model.
records.limitations: The 11× figure is model-specific, applies a 17% replicability adjustment and assumptions about government take-up and persistence, and is not a current cash-transfer or organization-wide audited outcome.

records.evidenceModel: Founders Pledge summary of GiveWell partner research on unconditional cash transfers
records.nativeMetric: Roughly 83% of each donated dollar transferred to recipients in the reviewed model
records.fundingStatus: Page says substantial funding can be used productively; no current numeric gap
records.summary: Founders Pledge presents GiveDirectly as a transparent, well-studied cash-transfer opportunity based on GiveWell's underlying research.
records.limitations: This is explicitly a partner-derived 2022 summary, not an independent Founders Pledge CEA or a current funding-gap estimate.
